what: Bausch and Lomb makes eye products: contact lenses and lens care, surgical equipment and implants for cataract surgery, and eye medicines including dry eye treatments.
customers: Optometrists, ophthalmic surgeons, pharmacies and consumers buying lenses and eye drops.
money: contact lenses, lens solutions and eye vitamins
cataract equipment, intraocular lenses and instruments
moat: A brand that has been on eye care shelves for 170 years, plus surgical equipment installed in operating theatres that locks in the consumables used with it.
risks: A $111M net loss as the Xiidra acquisition is absorbed
Majority owned by Bausch Health, whose own debt problems have overshadowed the company
opportunities: Revenue grew from $3.8B to $5.1B in four years
$252M of free cash flow and analysts see about 6% upside
A full separation from Bausch Health would remove the overhang that has kept the valuation down
watch: Vision Care organic growth and any move to separate fully from Bausch Health.
